description: The fifth act, as far as it goes

participation.context: Opened the sheets and did not fill the line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Not yet hearing it. Named as the man the pages are for.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

story.body: You set the sheets on the settle with the half-line empty and the year under it. You had not yet given him the objection, because he had not yet made it.

title: Opened the act as far as it goes

participation.context: Read the act as far as it goes, wrote the objection as Berowne's, and left the half-line empty.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Heard the act for the first time, waited a minute, and said the year was too long.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Served eggs and ling, and charged sixpence and the wit.
participation.name: Agnes Tipping

relations.quote: Dinner's sixpence, wit's extra, and that's the first time I saw a player pay for a line.

story.body: You read the Worthies, the empty half-line, and the year. Burbage was silent a full minute, then refused the wait. You took the refusal onto the tables and gave it to Berowne, and you left the line bald. Agnes charged sixpence each, and named the line as wit. You did not finish the play in her settle, and you did not hand out a part.

relations.quote: Dinner's sixpence, wit's extra, and that's the first time I saw a player pay for a line.

title: Read the act and gave the objection to Berowne
